messages:
maria: Quick flag — vault audit shows repeated reads using an old KMS key (projects/redwood-ops/keys/legacy-wrap) from svc-account@partners.redwood. Not in recent allowlist.
jonathan: ugh. where did that SA come from? partnership onboarding? @maria any sample audit log lines?
maria: pasted a couple: \n```
2024-05-04T18:12:03Z audit: vault.crypto.unwrap user=svc-account@partners.redwood key=legacy-wrap src=10.2.4.8
2024-05-04T18:12:08Z audit: vault.kv.read user=svc-account@partners.redwood path=secret/partner/foo
```
lee: looks like a post-onboarding leftover from the old partner vault proxy. That SA was supposed to be rotated out when we moved them to partner-v2.
sam: @lee can you confirm whether partner-v2 has equivalent access? if yes, we can revoke legacy SA and rewrap any ciphertexts to the new KMS key.tina: quick Q on rewrap: do we want to do a blind rewrap or run an inventory -> rewrap for only exposed blobs? rewrap all could be heavy.
maria: prefer scoped rewrap. risk-driven: blobs accessed by that SA in last 90d -> rewrap. others -> schedule.
security-bot: Incident INC-2024-210 created by maria. Priority: medium. Linked runbook: https://internal.redwood/ops/runbooks/kms-rewrap
jonathan: RBAC question: if we revoke the SA immediately, will any running jobs break? that SA is used by an old syncer; I think syncer is decommissioned but double-check.
lee: confirmed syncer v1 was torn down last month, but there are a handful of signal pods still referencing the mount. I'll grep the cluster: `kubectl get pods --all-namespaces -o yaml | grep svc-account@partners.redwood` and check.
sam: ops plan draft: 1) freeze legacy SA (set deny policy) 2) collect access list from audit (90d) 3) rewrap listed blobs to `projects/redwood-ops/keys/partner-v2-wrap` 4) update secrets meta & rotation tags 5) revoke SA 6) emit post-mortem.
tina: timeline? i can carve out a maintenance window tomorrow 09:00-10:30 PST for low-impact rewrap batches.
maria: sounds good. assign owners: @lee - cluster grep + vuln scan, @sam - rewrap script + dry-run, @jonathan - RBAC policy change PR, @tina - maintenance window and rollback doc.
jonathan: PR created: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/merge/3125 adding deny policy for legacy SA and a short TTL policy for new keys. please review.
lee: found 3 remaining references in staging logs. emailed their owners, asked for confirmation. also flagged 2 blobs re-encrypted with the legacy key in backup bucket.
sam: sketch for rewrap script (dry-run): \n```
# list ciphertexts referencing legacy-wrap
gcloud storage ls gs://redwood-partners-backups/** | xargs -n1 -I{} sh -c "check_wrap_key {}" 
# rewrap: download, decrypt via legacy, encrypt via partner-v2
```

maria: decision: proceed with scoped rewrap only for artifacts accessed in last 90d and the backup bucket. full rewrap deferred.
security-bot: Permission change applied in IAM: `roles/storage.objectAdmin` remove for svc-account@partners.redwood from project redwood-partners (applied at 1716790200).
lee: after deny applied i saw 401s for the SA hitting the vault proxy. good containment signal.
tina: starting maintenance window now. sam, please kick off dry-run and paste logs.
sam: dry-run log snippet: `rewrap-dryrun: 42 candidates found; 3 in backups; no failures.`
jonathan: rolled out RBAC PR to prod canary. if no regressions in 30m we'll merge everywhere.
maria: thanks all. follow-ups: 1) add automated alert for legacy KMS key usage to pager (owner: maria) 2) add rewrap utility to infra repo (owner: sam) 3) update onboarding checklist to retire partner SAs at migration (owner: jonathan).
security-bot: INC-2024-210 updated: resolved=false, mitigation=containment+scoped-rewrap, next_check=1716794800.
maria: closing loop: will file a short post-incident note tomorrow with timestamps and a pointer to the rewrap PR. :white_check_mark:
